from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A company's administrative expense record from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    expense_amount: str | None = Field(description="The administrative expense amount as reported (raw text)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the expense amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[ExpenseRecord]
